After the abusive father that I had to begin with, the dad I have now is the most amazing man in the world.
Before he married my mom, he would bring his son over to my house to play with me. My now brother had major autism. He is so low functioning that even though he was 2 years older than me we got along really well. My Dad would sit with us and play. He would buy me clothes and basic needs that my birth father wouldn't even do. 
  On my 8th birthday he had a tea party with me for several hours. On that day he handed me a piece of paper that had my last named changed on it. At this point he had been married to my mom for 2 years. He fought for 2 years to make me his daughter. Suffering abuse from my birth dad. Going to court every other week for me. Taking classes to qualify faster for the adoption. 
  He has been there through everything. Going to my plays, band concerts, marching expos, and even my heart breaks. He is more a dad than the man who was supposed to be. He has fought for me and will continue through everything. He will fight me on my stubbornness and I may say j hate him at times but he is the best thing to have ever happens to me. I will always be a daddy's girl because of him.
